# Feature: Product Recommendations

**Specification:** Product Recommendations - TBD

**Author:** Generated by Claude Code
**Status:** Draft

---

## 1. Overview

### What & Why
Display category-based product recommendations on the product detail page so customers can discover related items in our catalog. Category-based selection was chosen for the MVP so we get a clean signal to measure before investing in co-purchase data.

### Target Users & Success Metrics
- **Users:** Online shoppers browsing product detail pages
- **Success Metrics:**
  - Achieve an 8% click-through rate on the recommendation slot within the first quarter

---

## 2. User Journey

### Primary Workflow: View recommendations on a product page
**When:** A shopper opens any product detail page

**Steps:**
1. User opens a product detail page
2. System displays the main product
3. System displays the recommendation slot at the bottom of the page, below the main product information
4. User can click any recommendation to navigate to that product's detail page

**Success:** The shopper sees relevant products from the same category and can click through to them.

**Edge Cases:**
- Category has very few products (e.g. drinkware has only four): the same three items will be recommended every time. Accepted for the MVP.

---

## 3. Requirements

### Must Have (Core Features)
* **Recommendation slot placement:** Renders at the bottom of the product detail page, below the main product information.
* **Maximum recommendations:** [OPEN QUESTION: Is the cap 3 or 4 items?]
* **Category-based selection:** Recommendations are drawn from the same category as the current product.
  - [OPEN QUESTION: How are items selected from within the category — random, bestsellers, most recently added?]
* **"Frequently bought together" heading:** The slot is titled "Frequently bought together".
* **Recommendation caching:** Computed recommendations are cached for 15 minutes to keep product page load times acceptable.

### Out of Scope
* Co-purchase-based recommendations (deferred until after the MVP measures category-based performance)

### Constraints & Dependencies
* _To be defined_
